description: This file defines the TestEvent class in the org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.event package. It contains two static methods, one for testing event handling and another for testing HTTP client functionality. It references external utility classes for debugging and HTTP requests.

classes.name: TestEvent
classes.description: A class providing static methods to handle test events and HTTP client testing within the web application.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Handles a test event by setting a message attribute in the request and logging the event.

methods.name: httpClientTest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to a test URL, sets headers and parameters, and logs the result or exception.
